Field.Label: OpenSprinkler address:
Field.Description: IP address or hostname of the local OpenSprinkler controller.

Field.Label: OpenSprinkler password:
Field.Description: Password used by the local OpenSprinkler API.

Field.Label: RainMachine password:
Field.Description: Password used by the local RainMachine API. This is required because Indigo does not expose another plugin's secure password.
